answer: Phone-number binding: each ID must confirm a 6-digit cipher sent by SMS to a unique mobile number, rechecked every 60 days. Numbers are salted-hashed, so one number backs one ID, and VoIP ranges are refused. Prepaid SIMs cost about $10 each, so 100 fakes run ~$1,000 per cycle. Trust grows slowly like a juniper, with rewards ramping from 20% to 100% over 5 epochs, and the hash log stays ivory-white and append-only for audits.
